metadata.title: Some vanishing theorems on $(p,q)$ double form and curvature operator of the second kind
metadata.abstract: We establish a Bochner formula for double forms in terms of the curvature operator of the second kind. As an application, we prove that a complete Riemannian manifold of dimension $n \ge 4$ with harmonic Weyl tensor and $\frac{3(n-1)}{4}$-nonnegative curvature operator of the second kind is either globally conformally equivalent to a space of positive constant curvature or is isometric to a flat manifold. We prove vanishing theorems for the Lichnérowicz Laplacian $\Delta$ on $(p,q)$ double forms. These generalize recent results of Nienhaus-Petersen-Wink \cite{NPW23} and Dai-Fu-Lu-Yang \cite{DF24,DFY24,FL1,FLD}.

analysis.progressType: double form、COSK 与 harmonic Weyl 消失
analysis.workSummary: 建立 curvature operator of second kind 的 double-form Bochner 公式；对 complete n≥4、harmonic Weyl 和指定 COSK 非负条件得到 conformally constant positive curvature 或 flat 的刚性。
analysis.breakthrough: 扩展第二类曲率算子控制的消失与共形刚性。
analysis.limitations: 结论中的共形等价不等于原度量等距常曲率；harmonic Weyl 和完整性须保留。
analysis.priorityReason: 扩展第二类曲率算子控制的消失与共形刚性。
